positions.name: VelociraptorRetroFormatAdoption
positions.frame: how is the team retrospective process structured and transitioned to the Velociraptor format?
positions.why: The expressions cohere around establishing the Velociraptor retrospective framework, defining its three operational categories (Sailed, Stalled, Capsized), and identifying it as the successor to the team's previous start-stop-continue format.
